title: Ad Demand Partnerships Manager (Remote)

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, helping publishers maximize revenue by building strong, transparent, and diversified demand partnerships. We work with leading DSPs, SSPs, ad networks, and agencies worldwide to create a more competitive auction environment that drives higher fill rates and stronger returns for publishers across web, app, and CTV. This role is central to that mission: scaling and optimizing our global demand stack, forging strategic relationships with top programmatic buyers, and ensuring sustainable, diversified revenue growth.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Manager of Ad Demand Partnerships to dramatically expand and nurture and optimize our programmatic demand partnerships stack. This is a critical, revenue-generating role focused on forging new strategic relationships with global and niche Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs), Supply Side Platforms (SSPs), Ad Networks, and other premium demand partner sources.

Your success will be measured by your ability to increase competition within our ad stack, resulting in higher fill rates and Session RPMs/CPMs for our publishers' inventory across all platforms (web, app, and CTV).

Key Responsibilities Demand Acquisition & Financial Strategy
  • New Partner Sourcing: Proactively identify, prioritize, negotiate, and close new demand partnership agreements with top-tier global and regional advertising platforms (DSPs, Ad Networks, Media Agencies, Trading Desks).
  • Contract Negotiation: Strategically negotiate solid revenue share models and favorable payment terms with demand partners, ad networks that mutually benefit both MonetizeMore and our Publishers.
  • Key Account Focus: Establish and maintain high-level relationships with major programmatic buyers, including companies like The Trade Desk, MediaMath, Amazon, Criteo, and similar companies.
  • Revenue Diversification: Optimize the auction bid pressure from non-Google demand partners to diversify revenue sources for MonetizeMore publishers. Increase the Share of Voice (SOV) from revenue originating from Non-Google Demand to improve our overall revenue diversification.
  • Inventory Expansion: Seek opportunities to add value to our publishers' inventory by targeting local ad agencies that may be interested in buying direct inventory or PMP deals.
  • Media Kit Development: Create a professional solid media kit and compelling pitch materials that will entice demand partners, ad networks, and agencies to buy our inventory.
Technical Integration & Operational Oversight
  • Header Bidding Expertise: Initiate and lead the technical and business integration of new demand partners via MonetizeMore’s proprietary Header Bidding wrapper, ensuring seamless and low-latency performance.
  • Platform Diversification: Drive monetization growth across emerging channels, including Connected TV (CTV), Mobile App Monetization, and other high-growth video environments.
  • Financial Flow Ownership: Take ownership of the payment pipeline and work closely with the Finance Team to ensure demand partner payments are received on time and continue to avoid issues paying our publisher payments are always received on time.
  • Integration Process Management: Work closely with our Ad Ops and Engineering teams to manage the technical onboarding lifecycle process, including seamless communication between ad ops and demand partner setup on new publishers, from initial testing to full launch and optimization.
Communication & Reporting
  • High-Impact Communication: Clearly and effectively communicate complex technical and business terms to both internal teams and external executive partners.
  • Documentation & Training: Break down complex demand integration processes into simple, clear chunks for internal training and documentation.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay ahead of industry trends (privacy changes, identity solutions, supply path optimization, etc.) and translate their impact into actionable demand strategies.
Required Qualifications
  • Experience: 3+ years of successful experience in a Demand Partnerships, Business Development, or Supply/Monetization role within the Ad Tech or Publisher space.
  • Industry Knowledge: Solid, expert-level understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, including Header Bidding (Prebid), SSPs, DSPs, and Ad Exchanges.
  • Strategic Negotiator: Proven ability to negotiate and manage commercial contracts, specifically focusing on revenue share and net payment terms.
  • Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of ad demand integration processes, including VAST/VPAID for video, SDKs for app monetization, and general ad serving logic.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to solve problems, initiate partnerships via cold outreach, negotiate and present to senior leaders and executive-level contacts.
  • Organization: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and adept at managing multiple complex projects simultaneously.
Bonus Qualifications (A Major Plus)
  • Deep DSP Network: Existing contacts and relationships with key decision-makers at The Trade Desk or other major DSPs and SSPs/Trading Desks.
  • Trade Desk Experience: Previous employment experience at The Trade Desk or a similar Tier-1 DSP.
  • Global Focus: Experience managing demand partners and monetization across diverse international markets (EMEA, APAC, LATAM).

title: Model Auditor
description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About the role

Being a Model Auditor at Nubank is different from being a traditional auditor. In a digital bank driven by data, Machine Learning, and Artificial Intelligence, our audit function also embraces technology to assess risks predictively and continuously.

This position is fundamental to Nu's success. You will be part of the Internal Audit team, focusing on Financial Risks (Credit, Market, Liquidity, and Capital). Your primary goal will be to provide assurance on Nubank's financial models.

You'll be responsible for

Your main challenge will be to translate statistical and data concepts into auditable financial risks. Your activities will include:

  • Evaluating and critiquing risk models (including statistical and Machine Learning models), from their conception, development, and validation to their ongoing monitoring.
  • Applying your knowledge of mathematics and statistics to analyze the robustness, performance, and adherence of these models.
  • Executing audit tests using data analysis, you will be expected to explore large volumes of data to identify risks, biases, or control failures.
  • Leading technical discussions with stakeholders (such as Data Scientists, Engineers, and the Risk team) and communicating audit findings clearly, objectively, and constructively (both verbally and in writing).
  • Preparing audit reports and following up on the implementation of action plans to remediate identified vulnerabilities.
We are looking for a person who has
  • Strong knowledge in mathematics and statistics, and experience applying these concepts to analyze or build models (whether in data science, credit, finance, or related fields).
  • Practical experience with data analysis. While you don't need to master a specific language (like Python or SQL), you must have experience in extracting, manipulating, and analyzing data to generate insights.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. You know how to explain complex technical concepts in simple terms to various audiences.
  • An analytical and problem-solving profile, with strong critical thinking skills to break down complex problems and propose solutions.
  • Is organized and detail-oriented, without losing sight of the big picture.
  • Previous experience or knowledge in Internal Audit, Internal Controls, or Risk Management (especially Credit Risk or Market Risk) is a plus
  • Knowledge of the financial market, credit products, or fintechs is a plus
Benefits
  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Medical Plan
  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

Perched on the world-famous Copacabana Beach, the Fairmont Copacabana is one of Rio de Janeiro’s most prestigious luxury addresses and a symbol of the city’s glamorous lifestyle. With 375 rooms and suites, many offering panoramic views of the ocean and Sugar Loaf Mountain, the hotel blends timeless elegance with the vibrant energy of Rio.

As a leading destination for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, hosting everything from high-profile international conferences to glamorous weddings and social gatherings. With its enviable beachfront location, modern design infused with local culture, and a legacy of warm Brazilian hospitality, the Fairmont Copacabana embodies the art de vivre of Fairmont while standing as an icon of Rio de Janeiro’s luxury hotel scene.

Job Description

As the General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana , you will embody the essence of luxury hospitality. Your dynamic and hands-on approach is fueled by a deep passion for developing people and fostering an entrepreneurial spirit. A true brand and guest ambassador, you will challenge conventions, consistently seek solutions, and infuse innovation into every facet of the hotel experience and every function of the business.

Your seasoned leadership style will blend diplomacy with relationship-building prowess, cultivating strong connections with both internal and external stakeholders, including Owners and the Community. Your ability to engage with ownership and strategize revenue enhancements will be coupled with an innate talent for envisioning the hotel's long-term trajectory.

A refined sense of finance and business acumen will be at the core of your decision-making, grounded in an unwavering commitment to delivering a world-class product and service. By seamlessly weaving local heritage and culture into our offerings, you will not only create an authentic guest experience but also drive excellence across all dimensions of our operations.

In your role as a catalyst for exceptional service, you will uphold the highest standards, infusing every interaction with the kind of genuine care that leaves an indelible mark on our guests. Nurturing an environment of continuous growth and skill development, you will inspire our colleagues to consistently exceed expectations, turning moments into memories for every visitor.

As a visionary leader, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our strategic direction. Your involvement in goal setting and objective communication will propel business growth and solidify the hotel’s reputation as a distinguished luxury destination. Your ability to foster positive relationships with ownership will ensure a harmonious partnership that aligns with our overarching strategy while enhancing the hotel's performance and prestige.

Your leadership will be synonymous with setting industry benchmarks and redefining luxury hospitality. Your commitment to excellence, coupled with your innovative approach, will leave an enduring mark on our iconic brand and create a legacy of unparalleled guest memories.

Reporting Structure

The General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana will report to the Cluster Delegate Manager for Rio de Janeiro Luxury Hotels , as part of the unique cluster structure that unites Accor’s flagship luxury properties in the city.

Qualifications

Key Behaviours and Responsibilities:

  1. 1. Act with an open mindset:

    Embrace innovative ideas, adapt to change, and encourage a culture of innovation and continuous learning. Demonstrate explicit knowledge and awareness of company standards as an integral role model. Build quality relationships with the management team. Create an environment that encourages innovation, challenges traditional thinking, and fosters a "speak-up" culture.

  2. 2. Create positive impact working with others:

    Foster an inclusive and collaborative work environment, empowering colleagues to contribute their best and building strong relationships based on trust and respect. Create a collaborative and inclusive environment where all colleagues are encouraged to provide input. Actively listen to team members' ideas, concerns, and feedback and incorporate their input into decision-making processes. Recognize and appreciate the contributions and well-being of colleagues.

  3. 3. Strive for guest/client satisfaction:

    Exhibits a deep understanding of the luxury hospitality landscape and guest expectations, ensuring that the guest experience consistently exceeds industry standards. Maintain product and service quality standards by conducting ongoing evaluations. Handle VIP Guests and understand international protocols for government officials and royalty. Monitor guest/client feedback, address concerns promptly, and implement improvements to optimize satisfaction.

  4. 4. Consistently deliver excellence:

    Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of ownership group's investment objectives and formulates strategic business plans that align with those objectives; ensuring preservation and maximization of the hotel’s assets. Set high performance standards, lead by example, and drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality across all the hotel. Exhibits expertise in sales, marketing, and revenue management, driving the hotel's performance in the luxury hospitality market. Maximize financial performance, control costs, and execute marketing and operational activities that produce results meeting or exceeding the hotel's business plan. Recognize and reward outstanding performance and celebrate achievements within the organization.

  5. 5. Enable team success:

    Support the professional growth and development of colleagues through coaching, mentoring, and providing opportunities for learning. Encourage individuals to take on challenging assignments and stretch their capabilities. Provide regular feedback and guidance, recognizing achievements and offering constructive suggestions for improvement. Create a safe and empowering environment where individuals feel comfortable taking risks, expressing their ideas, and learning from failures. As applicable, brings experience in working with labor unions, maintaining constructive relationships and ensuring harmonious teamwork.

  6. 6. Create clarity:

    Articulates a clear and comprehensive vision for the hotel, aligning goals and objectives with ownership group's investment strategy. Effectively communicates organizational vision, goals, and expectations, fostering a shared sense of purpose and direction among team members. Demonstrates adeptness in overseeing renovation projects, maintaining transparency and open communication throughout the process. Addresses ambiguity and navigates complex situations with transparency, fostering an environment of clear direction and effective problem-solving.

  7. 7. Inspire for top performance:

    Lead with passion and integrity, motivate and inspire others to achieve their best. Market plans and ideas successfully, reducing key and complex ideas and messages to clear, memorable, and compelling statements. Embodies an entrepreneurial spirit, inspiring innovative thinking and fostering a culture that encourages taking calculated risks. Recognizes and rewards outstanding performance, cultivating an atmosphere of achievement and recognition. Promotes continuous development and growth, offering resources and guidance to nurture professional skills and talents. Champions a "speak-up" culture, creating an environment where diverse opinions are valued, and individual contributions are celebrated. Convince others, negotiate, debate, and find win-win solutions.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments
YOUR PROFILE
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

title: Design Director, UI/UX & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

That role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior-level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e-commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. É responsável por visitar os postos conforme a rota definida, verificando a presença, postura, uniforme e equipamentos dos vigilantes, assegurando o cumprimento das normas operacionais estabelecidas. Também acompanha as escalas de trabalho, confirma a presença dos profissionais nos turnos e providencia coberturas em casos de faltas ou atrasos, realizando os devidos ajustes conforme as necessidades operacionais.

Entre suas atribuições está a aplicação de treinamentos práticos e rápidos no próprio local de trabalho (on-the-job), com foco na correção de falhas e reforço dos procedimentos de segurança. Além disso, é responsável por preencher checklists operacionais, relatar ocorrências, irregularidades e comunicar qualquer anormalidade à central ou à gerência.

Mantém contato frequente com os responsáveis nos locais de vigilância, avaliando a satisfação do cliente em relação aos serviços prestados e repassando os feedbacks à gestão.     • Develop dynamic, visually compelling presentation decks and engagement proposals that clearly articulate service offerings, project scope, value propositions, and strategic recommendations.
    • Customize deliverables to reflect client‑specific challenges and opportunities uncovered during discovery meetings.
    • Integrate technical insights with business strategy, ensuring that proposals account for both immediate deliverables and long‑term client growth.
  • Team Buildout and Project Kickoff:
    • Act as the primary point of coordination among Sales, Recruiting, and Engineering teams, ensuring smooth hand‑offs from initial engagement through team buildout to project kick‑off.
    • Serve as a “concierge” for deals, maintaining fluid communication and alignment across functions to drive successful client onboarding.
    • Serve as a trusted advisor during pre‑sales engagements by translating complex technical aspects into digestible, business‑focused narratives.
    • Maintain a sales/consulting mindset throughout the technical discovery process, ensuring proposals align with targeted business outcomes.

  • 3+ years of experience in similar Sales & Delivery Management roles.

  • UX & Presentation Design Acumen: solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking, enabling effective discussion of digital product experiences; proven track record of creating high‑quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals.

  • Team Collaboration & Cross‑Functional Coordination: demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from the funnel stage to the kickoff; capability to serve as a liaison, ensuring alignment and clarity among Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting teams.
  • Consultative Sales Experience: prior experience in a pre‑sales, sales engineering, or technical consulting role, ideally within a digital software consultancy or similar environment; ability to quickly assess client needs and transform them into actionable insights and proposals.
PERKS AND BENEFITS
  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.

description:
Somos a Rede Hospital Casa um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Suas principais atividades serão:
  • Aplicar os conhecimentos técnicos de Segurança do Trabalho de modo a reduzir, neutralizar ou eliminar os riscos à segurança do trabalhador;
  • Orientar o sistema de segurança do trabalho, investigando riscos e causas de acidentes, fazendo as necessárias recomendações para evitar acidentes semelhantes, analisando esquemas de prevenção, observando dispositivos legais e institucionais que objetivem a eliminação, controle ou redução permanente dos riscos de acidentes do trabalho e a melhoria das condições do ambiente, para preservar a integridade física e mental dos trabalhadores;
  • Inspecionar locais, instalações e equipamentos da empresa e determinar fatores de riscos de acidentes;
  • Realizar auditorias internas e treinamentos de Segurança do Trabalho em todos os Setores da unidade Hospitalar, de forma rotineira, identificando condições insalubres e perigosas, tomando todas as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de riscos, bem como orientar e conscientizar os colaboradores quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho;
  • Elaborar e implementar política de saúde, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente (SSMA);
  • Exigir o cumprimento das condições básicas de Segurança do Trabalho para empresas prestadoras de serviço e contratadas para execução de serviços nas dependências do estabelecimento hospitalar;

  • Controlar, distribuir e inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI);
  • Elaborar documentos de segurança do trabalho como Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais, dentre outros;

  • Propor normas e dispositivos de segurança, sugerindo eventuais modificações nos equipamentos e instalações e verificando sua observância, para prevenir acidentes;
  • Inspecionar os postos de combate a incêndios, examinando as mangueiras, hidrantes, extintores e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndios;
  • Comunicar os resultados de suas inspeções à coordenação do SESMT, elaborando relatórios;

  • Registrar irregularidades e elaborar estatísticas de acidentes;
  • Promover campanhas, cursos, palestras e outras formas de treinamento com o objetivo de divulgar as normas de segurança e higiene do trabalho, bem como informar e conscientizar os trabalhadores sobre atividades insalubres, perigosas e penosas;

title: Consultor(a) SAP PLM
description:
Sobre a Motivus


Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Irá analisar processos existentes, configurar módulos como DMS e ECM, garantir integrações entre PLM e outros módulos SAP, além de definir estratégias de migração e conduzir testes funcionais. Você colaborará com equipes diversificadas, incentivará a comunicação multifuncional e contribuirá para projetos que terão um impacto significativo em nossos clientes e na indústria.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Liderar e apoiar migrações do ECC para o S/4HANA dentro do domínio PLM.

  • Configurar módulos SAP PLM, incluindo Document Management System (DMS), Engineering Change Management (ECM), Product Structure Management e Recipe/Formulation Management.
  • Garantir a integração entre PLM e outros módulos (MM, PP, SD, QM).
  • Definir estratégia de migração, mapeamento e regras de transformação.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais e colaborar com as equipes ABAP e Basis para desenvolvimentos customizados.
  • Apoiar atividades de migração de dados, validações e reconciliações.
  • Executar testes unitários, testes de integração e apoiar o UAT (User Acceptance Test) com os usuários-chave do negócio.
  • Fornecer suporte funcional e resolver incidentes durante e após a migração.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e ministrar treinamentos para usuários-chave.
  • Seguir metodologias SAP (ASAP, Activate, Agile) durante a execução dos projetos.


Qualificações


  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Consultor SAP PLM.
  • Experiência prática em projetos de migração ECC → S/4HANA.
  • Sólido conhecimento em DMS, ECM e integrações de processos PLM.
  • Entendimento de gestão de dados mestres e seu papel no PLM.
  • Experiência com ciclos de teste (UT, IT, UAT).
  • Inglês avançado ou superior.
  • Espanhol intermediário ou superior.
  • Conhecimento de aplicativos Fiori para PLM no S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de migração de dados (LTMC, LSMW, SAP Migration Cockpit).
  • Familiaridade com SAP Solution Manager para documentação e testes.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.
  • Capacidade de atuar em equipes internacionais e multifuncionais.


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.

  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente: Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores


  • Cultura de Inovação: Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Mid-Level)
description:
Technical Support Engineer (Mid-Level)

Location: Remote (Brazil. or Latin America preferred)

Company: Hitch, Inc.


About Hitch

Hitch builds the digital infrastructure powering modern home equity and non-QM lending. Our white-label platform enables lenders to launch HELOC, DSCR, bridge, and home equity products faster — with integrated point of sale, broker portals, and automated underwriting.

We partner with leading mortgage lenders like Deephaven Mortgage and MyEQNow to deliver a seamless borrower and broker experience.


Role Overview

We are seeking a Technical Support Engineer to join our operations and product team. You will act as the primary technical contact for our clients — diagnosing platform issues, tracing bugs, and communicating findings clearly between client operations teams and Hitch’s engineers.

This is a hands-on role ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of customer experience and technology.


Responsibilities
  • Serve as Tier 2 support for lender and broker clients, escalating bugs and complex issues to engineering when needed.
  • Investigate client-reported issues by analyzing logs, API requests, database records, and user behavior.
  • Reproduce and document bugs with clear replication steps, timestamps, and expected vs. actual results.
  • Collaborate with developers and QA to verify fixes and regression-test key features.
  • Use tools like Postman, AWS CloudWatch, and browser developer tools to debug integrations.
  • Maintain support documentation, internal runbooks, and root-cause analyses.
  • Monitor application health metrics and proactively identify potential system issues.
  • Participate in weekly technical support syncs with Product and Engineering.


Requirements
  • 2–5 years of experience in technical support, QA engineering, or DevOps support for SaaS or fintech platforms.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication (C1 or native-level).
  • Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads , and browser console/network tools.
  • Ability to read and interpret basic SQL queries or error logs .
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when documenting issues.
  • Experience with ticketing systems (Zendesk, Linear, Asana, or Jira).
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with developers and client success teams.


Nice-to-Have
  • Background in mortgage, lending, or real estate technology (LOS, POS, or Encompass integration).
  • Knowledge of AWS , Node.js , or React debugging.
  • Experience working with Plaid, Truework, Prudent AI, or other fintech APIs .
  • Portuguese or Spanish proficiency (to collaborate with our Brazil-based engineering team).


Why Hitch
  • Work closely with a global engineering team building the future of digital lending.
  • Exposure to real-world integrations across fintech, credit, and mortgage ecosystems.
  • Growth opportunities into QA, DevOps, or Client Success Engineering.
  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.



Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:
SONDA is the largest IT service provider in Latin America, leader in systems integration, support and IT outsourcing. With almost 50 years of experience and in constant growth around the World, and growing so far in in US, as well.


We are looking for a Network Operations Analyst to join our client’s Early Shift team, providing first-line monitoring and coordination of network incidents across multiple retail locations. This professional will act as the main communication point between the client and the Managed Service Provider (MSP), ensuring timely updates, incident tracking, and clear communication with internal stakeholders.

  • Excellent organizational and coordination abilities.
  • Availability to work from 5:00 AM to 12:00 PM ET (early shift).

  • Basic certifications such as CompTIA Network+ or CCNA are a plus.

title: Especialista DevOps Sênior (Cloud & IA)
description:
Sobre a Vaga

Como Especialista DevOps Sênior Cloud & IA, você será a peça-chave na evolução da infraestrutura que suporta nossa plataforma de IA . Sua missão abrangerá três pilares centrais: a migração estratégica de nossos serviços da Azure para a AWS; a otimização de performance e custos (FinOps) em ambientes Kubernetes; e a implementação de infraestrutura para processamento de IA open-source na AWS. Esta é uma função crítica que exige profundo conhecimento técnico em operações de nuvem, segurança (DevSecOps) e um interesse genuíno no emergente campo de AIOps.


Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, executar e validar a migração completa da infraestrutura de cloud, movendo as cargas de trabalho da Azure para a AWS, garantindo mínima disrupção e máxima eficiência.
  • Assumir a arquitetura e customização do ambiente Kubernetes (K8s), assegurando a escalabilidade e resiliência da plataforma "Pullse".
  • Implementar e otimizar técnicas avançadas de auto-scaling, utilizando HPA (Horizontal Pod Autoscaler) e KEDA (Kubernetes Event-driven Autoscaling) para responder dinamicamente às cargas de trabalho de IA.
  • Estruturar e operar a infraestrutura para processamento de modelos de IA open-source, utilizando AWS Bedrock como serviço gerenciado principal.
  • Aplicar rigorosas práticas de DevSecOps, com foco na gestão e rotação de secrets (segredos) em ambientes de contêineres.
  • Gerenciar e manter o AWS Cognito para autenticação e autorização de usuários na plataforma.
  • Implementar estratégias de FinOps, focando na otimização agressiva de custos através do uso e gerenciamento de instâncias Spot (EC2 Spot).


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) DevOps ou SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) em ambientes de alta disponibilidade.
  • Profundo conhecimento do ecossistema AWS (VPC, EC2, S3, IAM, EKS) e experiência prática com AWS Cognito.
  • Experiência sólida em migração de infraestrutura entre provedores de nuvem (especificamente Azure para AWS).
  • Domínio de ferramentas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) , especificamente Terraform ou AWS CloudFormation.
  • Domínio de Kubernetes (K8s), incluindo arquitetura, deployments, networking e segurança de clusters.
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de aplicações em K8s utilizando Helm e Kustomize.
  • Experiência prática na implementação de soluções de auto-scaling (HPA e/ou KEDA).
  • Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack) aplicadas a ambientes distribuídos.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de DevSecOps, notadamente na gestão de secrets (ex: AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault).
  • Experiência em AWS Bedrock ou serviços equivalentes para operações de modelos de IA.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência avançada em FinOps, com histórico comprovado de otimização de custos em nuvem (especialmente com instâncias Spot).
  • Certificações relevantes (ex: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, Certified Kubernetes Administrator - CKA).
  • Experiência anterior com ferramentas de orquestração de IA ou plataformas de MLOps.

title: Recruiter
description:
Apesar de ter muitas aplicações não deixe de se aplicar, focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.


Regime: PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral


Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas


Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 3.000 – 8.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$4.500 - 6.000), sem teto.

title: Data Quality Analyst
description:
Job Title: Data Quality Analyst

Purpose:

The Data Quality Analyst is responsible for auditing and testing enterprise applications with a focus on backend ETL (Extract, Transform & Load) processes and other software modules related to the creation of data warehouse reporting instruments , ensuring high-quality and reliable information. This role also involves creating ad-hoc queries to extract information from reporting sources as requested by business areas.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Follow established quality assurance standards and processes .
  • Determine and implement methods, flows, and procedures to improve QA and business processes.
  • Create and document test scripts to audit data integrity on an ongoing basis.
  • Test newly developed applications by creating test scenarios and verifying compliance with business requirements.
  • Analyze and resolve application and data issues as they arise.
  • Document production processes and objects for better understanding across IT and business users.
  • Handle ad-hoc data warehouse queries for end users as needed.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related business discipline from an accredited institution; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Data Quality Assurance , preferably in data warehousing or reporting environments .
  • At least 2 years of QA testing experience , ideally in data integrity assessment .
  • Preferably 2+ years of experience in the travel industry .
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities.

Technical Skills:

  • SQL and PL/SQL (Oracle platform preferred).
  • Strong understanding of ETL processes (Extract, Transform, Load).
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and architectures.
  • Experience creating and executing test scripts for data validation.
  • Strong data analysis and troubleshooting skills with large datasets.
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (tables, indexes, triggers, etc.).
  • Familiarity with reporting/BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, OBIEE, Cognos).
  • Intermediate English level (B2) – strong written and verbal communication required.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in team environments .
  • Capable of managing multiple projects and shifting priorities effectively.

Benefits:

  • Career development plan and continuous training opportunities.
  • Excellent work environment with flexibility.
  • Direct benefits from the client.
  • 100% remote work , or hybrid mode if you are based in Medellín.
  • A workplace where professional growth meets quality of life .
  • More than just a job offer – this is a life experience where you can grow professionally while enjoying a flexible, dynamic, and challenging environment .

title: Bilingual Account Executive (Hunter/Closer)
description:
SaaS Sales for DatBot.ai & Flipbooker.com • Selling to the U.S. market • PJ contractor


Why this role: Short cycles, clear ICP, good conversion, and uncapped commission on cash collected with higher rates for self-sourced deals.


About us


We’re a lean U.S. SaaS company with products used by modern marketing teams. Engineering is in Brazil; sales targets the U.S. We value clear writing, fast experiments, and cash-in over vanity metrics.


Products


DatBot.ai – AI workflows for agencies/SMBs to research, brief, and ship content faster.


Flipbooker.com – Turns PDFs into branded, gated microsites with analytics and access control.


The role


Full-cycle AE (hunter). You’ll prospect, run tight discovery, do short narrative demos, and close straightforward Team+ deals. Self-serve stays on the websites; you own outbound and expansions.


ICP (who you’ll sell)


U.S. SMB/mid-market: Heads/VPs of Marketing, Demand Gen, Product Marketing, eComm Managers, RevOps in non-regulated industries. Natural cross-sell between products.


What you’ll do


Self-source 60–80% of pipeline via email/phone/LinkedIn + short Looms; re-engage warm leads fast.


Run discovery (why change / impact / timeline ≤90 days), do a 5–8 min demo, propose paid pilots, and close Team+ plans.


Build segmented lead lists and sequences; log clean notes; share weekly insights; surface cross-sell opportunities.


Drive a close plan on every late-stage opp (dates, owners, legal/security steps).


How we measure success (outcomes, not busywork)


Ramp:


Month 1 → 4–8 Qualified Meetings; 2–3 SAOs; 1 early win ideal.


Month 2 → 12–18 QMH; 6–8 SAOs; 1–3 wins.


Steady state (M3+): 12–20 QMH / 6–10 SAOs / 2–4 wins per month.


Cash-in: US$8k–$15k+/mo once ramped (grows as we dial in).


Quality gates we care about: Show ≥70% • Show→SAO 45–60% • SAO→Win 20–35%.


You’ll be great here if you have:


Excellent English (spoken/written) for U.S. prospect calls.


2+ years SaaS BDR/AE (U.S. SMB/mid-market a plus).


Real hunter chops: list building, smart personalization, tight copy, disciplined follow-up.


Tools: HubSpot, Apollo or similar, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Loom, Calendly, Google Workspace.


Compensation (uncapped, paid on cash collected)


Base (PJ): US$1.2k–1.8k/mo + 25–40% on cash collected for self-sourced Team+ (≥US$2k ARR), 10–20% on assisted, with accelerators. Biweekly payouts.

(Attribution and tiers shared after the intro call; standard clawbacks for early churn.)


Schedule: Remote in Brazil with ~3–4 hours overlap to U.S. ET/PT.

Engagement: PJ contractor.


Interview process


Intro screen: product pitch + quick funnel/OTE math.


Skills gauntlet: cold-call opener, discovery + 5–8 min narrative demo, objection/negotiation.


Deal deep-dive with optional paid micro-trial if mutually useful.


How to apply


Send your CV, your proudest prospecting/closing win (3–5 sentences with metrics), and:


A 90-second Loom pitching Flipbooker to a U.S. VP Marketing.


Two first-touch emails (one for DatBot.ai, one for Flipbooker) aimed at different ICPs.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
NOSSAS PESSOAS, JUNTAS, LIDERAM COM CONSCIÊNCIA.

Na Natura, temos potencial para impulsionar transformações significativas. Isso é possível por meio dos produtos inovadores da Natura e Avon; das experiências marcantes dos serviços de beleza da Bluma e da nossa plataforma de educação financeira, a Emana Pay. Marcas e serviços relevantes para quem os utiliza e reconhecidos pelo nosso compromisso com a condução de negócios regenerativos.



Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção dos modelos regulatórios de risco de crédito (PD, LGD, EAD e Estágios IFRS9), garantindo aderência às normas IFRS9 e regulamentações do BACEN (Res. 4966, 229, 2682).
  • Ser responsável técnico pelas metodologias de provisionamento de perda esperada (ECL) da carteira de crédito, assegurando consistência entre o modelo, as bases de dados e as regras contábeis.
  • Estruturar e automatizar pipelines de cálculo de PD, LGD e EAD em ambiente Databricks (PySpark/SQL), integrando os modelos às bases de produção e garantindo rastreabilidade e governança.
  • Conduzir análises retroativas e de performance dos modelos (backtesting, estabilidade de variáveis, KS, AUC, PSI, curing rate, hazard e survival curves) para identificar desvios e propor evoluções metodológicas.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com as áreas de Crédito, Cobrança, Contabilidade, Financeiro e Risco, traduzindo necessidades do negócio em soluções analíticas robustas e sustentáveis.
  • Acompanhar práticas de mercado e evoluções regulatórias, propondo inovações que aumentem a eficiência do provisionamento e a precisão das estimativas de risco.


O que você precisa ter?

description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the role:


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented linguist to support AI training initiatives and linguistic content creation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.


Job Title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing



Key Responsibilities:


  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.


Qualifications:

  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.


Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:



  • Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency
  • A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify


Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Domínio sólido da linguagem de programação Java, incluindo POO, Generics, Programação Funcional (Lambdas, Streams), exceções, Reflection, testes unitários e ferramentas de build (Maven/Gradle).
  • Experiência com frameworks e bibliotecas Java populares (Spring, JPA (Hibernate), JUnit (4 e 5) e Mockito)
  • Experiência em documentação de APIs usando o padrão OpenAPI ou similares como Swagger, gerados automaticamente através do código da aplicação desenvolvida. É esperado que também consiga elaborar manualmente contratos de APIs usando OpenAPI.

  • Expertise em práticas e convenções para desenvolvimento de software como SOLID, design patterns, clean code e outras que valorizam melhores práticas.
  • Domínio em versionamento de código usando GIT, bem como resolução de conflitos em merges de branchs.
  • Experiência com a integração de APIs REST e serviços de terceiros, aplicando melhores práticas na elaboração de contratos de comunicação.
  • Experiência com soluções de mensageria (como AWS SQS, RabbitMQ ou similar) ou baseada em eventos (como Kafka, Azure Service Bus, GCP PubSub, AWS SNS ou similares).
  • Experiência com computação em nuvem, incluindo pelo menos um dos principais provedores: AWS (Lambda, S3, SQS, EC2, RDS), Azure (Functions, Blob Storage, Service Bus) ou GCP (Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Firestore).


Você irá se destacar e será considerado diferencial se:

  • Experiência com observabilidade (DataDog, NewRelic, Dynatrace) e implementação de dashboards.
  • Implementação de telemetria com OpenTelemetry.
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de resiliência com Resilient4J ou similares.
  • Experiência com gRPC e SSE (Server-Sent Events).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura hexagonal.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mock para APIs REST


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

Valorizamos e apoiamos a presença de mulheres em cargo de gestão, a contratação de pessoa com deficiência e o equilíbrio racial e de gênero em nossas equipes.

Essa é a nossa pegada! Gostou? Confira os detalhes da vaga abaixo:

O que a MAPFRE espera de você:

Nossos benefícios para você

A jornada diária conta com horário flexível, formato de trabalho híbrido, incentivo a saúde e qualidade de vida com Plano de Saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Auxílio Academia, Vale-Refeição, Vale-Alimentação, Incentivo a Previdência Privada, Day-off de aniversário, Vale-Transporte ou Fretado, PLR, condições especiais na contratação de seguros da MAPFRE, auxílio babá ou creche, Universidade Corporativa, descontos para estudos e seguro de Vida.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

description:

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Líder global em soluções transacionais , conecta empresas, empregados e comerciantes há mais de 50 anos.   • Projetar, desenvolver e apoiar na implantação de sistemas e aplicações conforme as tecnologias e padrões definidos.

  • Vivência no setor financeiro será um diferencial.

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Technical Recruiter
description:

title: Engenheiro DevOps
description:
Cargo: Engenheiro DevOps Sênior

Modelo: Remoto

Papel Principal

O(a) Engenheiro(a) DevOps será responsável por atuar em projetos internos e externos, colaborando com as equipes de arquitetura de solução e infraestrutura na definição de soluções tecnológicas voltadas aos processos de CI/CD , orquestração de containers em ambientes Cloud e OnPremise , além de garantir o monitoramento, observabilidade e automação dos sistemas.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como Engenheiro DevOps em projetos internos e externos da empresa.

  • Configurar pipelines de build e deploy, garantindo automação e qualidade.
  • Instalar e configurar componentes de gestão e orquestração de contêineres.
  • Gerenciar certificados TLS/SSL em ambientes de microserviços.
  • Configurar e manter ferramentas e dashboards de monitoramento e observabilidade.
  • Colaborar na definição de padrões e tecnologias para integração entre ambientes onPremise e Cloud.
  • Apoiar na análise e resolução de incidentes (troubleshooting) em ambientes aplicacionais.


Habilidades Técnicas

  • Inglês Intermediário (leitura e escrita).
  • Experiência sólida em orquestração de microserviços e containers (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift) em ambientes Cloud e OnPremise .
  • Profundo conhecimento em integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD) com ferramentas como Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD e Bitbucket Pipelines .
  • Domínio em automação de infraestrutura com Ansible, Chef e Terraform .
  • Aplicação, gestão e configuração de certificados TLS/SSL em ambientes de microserviços.
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação e desenvolvimento de software.
  • Conhecimento avançado em shell script e bash .
  • Experiência prática em infraestrutura OnPremise e integração com ambientes híbridos.
  • Vivência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure e/ou GCP), com foco em escalabilidade, performance e segurança.
  • Conhecimento em Git e GitLab CI/CD , com versionamento e integração contínua.
  • Experiência em configuração e operação de ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento (Grafana, ELK, Zabbix, Prometheus, Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, NewRelic).
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e análise de problemas junto às equipes de desenvolvimento e suporte.
  • Adaptabilidade para atuar em ambientes multi-tecnológicos , integrando aplicações e infraestrutura de diferentes naturezas.


Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

  • Comunicação assertiva e poder de síntese.
  • Proatividade e adaptabilidade.
  • Confiabilidade e empatia.
  • Forte habilidade de trabalho em equipe e colaboração .
  • Foco em solução de problemas e resultados .


Formação Acadêmica

  • Formação desejada: Ciência ou Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia de Redes ou áreas correlatas.
  • Outras formações em Exatas também serão consideradas.


Certificações Desejáveis

  • Certificações nas áreas de DevOps, CI/CD, SRE e Engenharia de Cloud serão considerados diferenciais.


Experiência

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em DevOps, CI/CD e/ou SRE .
  • Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência total em TI , considerando outras especialidades como desenvolvimento de sistemas ou engenharia de infraestrutura.
